summary: Diagnosed and fixed WhatsApp Baileys 440 reconnect loop, added clean generateQr method that clears stale credentials to guarantee instant QR generation; implemented missing saveAndSyncEmailChannel in app.js and added IMAP connection/socket timeouts to ensure reliable email sync feedback.

topic: Unified Email Credentials & Verified Inbox Reply Dispatch
summary: Unified Email configuration across the entire app so Leads cold pitch dispatcher and Omnichannel Inbox share the same AES-256 encrypted SMTP credentials from channel_settings (axurabots@gmail.com). Fixed inbox reply endpoint to auto-resolve channel credentials and send email replies via SMTP. Verified live email delivery to blinknship@gmail.com.

topic: Dual Port Support (3000 & 3005) & Node Watch Mode
summary: Resolved issue where user's browser was connected to stale server on port 3005 without hot reload. Terminated stale process, bound server to both 3000 and aux 3005, added node --watch to dev script, and verified live reply delivery from port 3005 to blinknship@gmail.com with active message ID.

topic: Automated Background IMAP Polling & Email Inbound Deduplication
summary: Fixed missing automatic incoming email sync by adding a background IMAP poller running every 25 seconds with concurrency lock. Implemented email messageId deduplication in inboxRepository.js to prevent duplicate imports. Verified inbound reply from blinknship@gmail.com is loaded in conversation 23.

topic: Session Resumed & Node Watch Path Scoping
summary: Resumed active session. Diagnosed node --watch restarting continuously due to node_modules/Baileys internal file touches; scoped dev script to --watch-path=server.js --watch-path=modules --watch-path=public. Successfully booted and verified server listening on ports 3000 & 3005 with active Email IMAP poller.

topic: Fixed Duplicate Outbound Dispatch & High-Speed Email Inbound/Outbound Sync
summary: Resolved issue where messages sent from inbox fired twice by eliminating duplicate keydown event listener in app.js, adding window.isSendingChatReply mutex, and adding a 3.5s server-side debounce map in inboxRouter.js. Re-engineered emailInboundSync.js with a 2-phase fetch (lightweight envelopes first, download source only for genuinely new un-synced emails, capped unseen search) reducing sync latency and eliminating IMAP stalls. Added In-Reply-To/References RFC headers for proper Gmail threading, mirrored Leads Hunter cold emails into the Inbox threads, and cleaned up historical duplicate messages in the database.

topic: Fixed Real-Time Inbox Sync & Outbound Reply Dispatch Stability
summary: Diagnosed and resolved two root bugs: (1) dev script watch thrashing on public and modules folders causing repeated server reboots, Supabase connection pool exhaustion (ETIMEDOUT 6543), and dropped outbound reply requests; (2) frontend real-time poller not tracking message IDs and bubble counts or auto-scroll on new inbound messages, requiring page reload to see incoming chats. Scoped watch to server.js only, converted IMAP phase 2 source fetch to single-query batch download to eliminate socket timeouts, and revamped frontend poller with lastMessageId and messageCount tracking and auto-scroll on new message arrivals.

topic: SMTP Connection Pooling, Batch IMAP Sync & Custom Email Subject
summary: Accelerated email sending latency from 4.5s down to 1.5s using a pooled keepalive SMTP transporter in mailer.js (pool: true, maxConnections: 3), reusing warm TLS connections instead of repeated handshakes. Replaced sequential Supabase SELECT queries in emailInboundSync.js with a single batch ANY($1::text[]) check, cutting envelope check time from 8s to under 500ms, and increased IMAP polling frequency to 12s. Implemented customizable Subject row in Omnichannel Inbox composer (public/index.html, public/style.css, public/app.js) that displays only for email threads, pre-fills current thread subject, permits custom edits, and updates conversations.subject in database on dispatch.

topic: n8n Meta Integration (Instagram & Facebook Messenger) & Verification Analysis
summary: Diagnosed user's device containing n8n v2.37.10 globally installed. Launched local n8n daemon on port 5678 and navigated user to editor. Enhanced metaReceiver.js with dynamic channel routing (instagram and facebook). Generated production-ready workflows workflows/n8n_instagram_client_bunny.json and workflows/n8n_meta_omnichannel_client_bunny.json. User imported and executed workflow; dispatched test event and verified 200 OK execution in n8n and message delivery into Supabase (message ID 312). Researched ManyChat and Make.com free tier restrictions (both require Meta Developer App / paid tiers). Identified Meta Developer 'In Development' mode as zero-verification pathway for personal page/IG messaging.

topic: Open & Click Tracking Engine, Dynamic Days Elapsed Cadence & Contextual AI Follow-Up Generator
summary: Architected and verified full outreach tracking and follow-up engine: 1x1 transparent GIF tracking pixel server (/api/track/open/:token), click wrapper (/api/track/click/:token), anti-spam bot filter, 4-tier cadence age calculator (Day 0-2 waiting, Day 3-6 gentle bump, Day 7-13 value add, Day 14+ breakup, auto-halt on reply), Gemini Flash AI follow-up generator with 'Re:' threading, and Leads Hunter UI integration with live cadence badges, mini tracking pills (opens/clicks), filter pills, and 1-click '⚡ Follow-Up' action. 100% verified via unit and DB integration tests.

topic: Dedicated Tracking & Analytics Dashboard & Pre-Flight Spam Risk Analyzer
summary: Segregated Outreach Tracking & Cadence into a dedicated 'Tracking & Analytics' dashboard in the sidebar and bottom mobile nav. Cleaned up Leads table and filter bar by removing tracking clutter, keeping Leads focused on business research. Built 5-card KPI metric grid, an interactive Pre-Flight Spam Risk Analyzer (/api/tracking/analyze-spam) scoring copy against 15+ B2B cold email spam patterns, and a live Outreach & Cadence Monitor Table (/api/tracking/logs) with engagement signals, cadence badges, and 1-click AI follow-up actions. Preserved secondary pipeline analytics in a collapsible panel. Verified end-to-end.

topic: Tracking & Analytics UI Hardening, SVG Migration, Responsiveness & Phase 2 Transition
summary: Eliminated all emojis across the UI in favor of crisp SVG icons, unified the design system to a clean monochrome white theme (#FFFFFF cards, #E4E4E7 borders, high contrast typography), and ensured 100% mobile responsiveness (zero sideways overflow at 375px). Verified all buttons, modals, and AI follow-up workflows with automated Playwright suite (tests/verify_tracking_ui.js). Audited codebase and synchronized project memory ledger in preparation for Phase 2 sprint.

topic: Supabase Cloud Unpause, Vercel Serverless Hardening & Production Recovery
summary: Diagnosed Supabase free tier inactivity pause and verified cloud PostgreSQL pooler reconnect with all 8 active tables intact. Fixed Vercel 500 FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED by adding missing pino dependency to package.json, lazy loading Playwright imports across crawler and dorker, guarding background IMAP auto-poller and WhatsApp Baileys socket against AWS Lambda serverless execution freezes with !process.env.VERCEL, configuring vercel.json includeFiles for static assets, and pushing to git main. Verified 100% live at https://client-bunny.vercel.app returning 200 OK across UI, tracking, and leads APIs.
